content.text:
Built a complete, playable free-kick game in `index.html`. Swipe upward to shoot: swipe speed controls power, and a curved swipe adds curl. The goalkeeper and defenders stay still; aim for the corners to score.

It includes a responsive pitch, swipe trail, score and best-score tracking, shot outcomes, and a reset button. I verified the game in Chromium and checked the JavaScript syntax. Assumption: “swapping” meant swiping.
